IC1: 1. Have a finding of a mass lesion [AND] on mammography [OR] or breast MRI [AND] (BIRADS 0, 4 or 5) that is >0.5 cm and < 2 cm in size and has had or will have additional workup with focused ultrasound.
IC2: 2. Have a finding of a mass lesion [AND] on ultrasound  (BIRADS 0, 4 or 5) [AND] that is > 0.5 cm and < 2 cm in size.
IC3: 3. Have a positive finding [AND] on MBI [AND] that is < 2 cm in size and requires additional diagnostic workup with focused ultrasound.
